IVYSAUR.assessment: Sleep and repeatable Grass/Poison damage support either active ally; removed Solar Beam/Growth/Weather Ball dependence because no fixed rival teammate supplies sun.

VENUSAUR.assessment: Fast sleep/Leaf Storm pressure with Earth Power coverage; Chlorophyll can exploit opposing sun without depending on it.

CHARMELEON.assessment: Immediate spread Fire plus Dragon/Rock coverage; Dragon Pulse replaces weak weather-dependent coverage in a team without its own weather setter.

CHARIZARD.assessment: Fast special Fire/Flying pressure with native-expanded Tailwind support; preserve the authored move despite the narrower reference omission.

WARTORTLE.assessment: Bulky Eviolite Shell Smash threatens special spread pressure; choose setup only with survival and speed payoff.

BLASTOISE.assessment: Bulky Fake Out/Yawn, Follow Me and Flip Turn support; preserve expanded redirection access and select moves for the actual partner.

BAYLEEF.assessment: Specially bulky Light Screen/Helping Hand support now retains Giga Drain, avoiding an all-status last-starter state.

MEGANIUM.assessment: Triage healing and draining offense protects a stronger active attacker; Light Screen gives a second support route.

QUILAVA.assessment: Eruption at high HP and Heat Wave after chip; Flash Fire offers a defensive entry against Fire.

TYPHLOSION.assessment: Scarf Eruption provides an immediate offensive reserve with coverage after HP loss; no allied sun assumed.

CROCONAW.assessment: Sheer Force Dragon Dance with Water/Ice coverage; Eviolite protects its setup window.

FERALIGATR.assessment: Life Orb Sheer Force offense can set up or attack immediately; relevant moves avoid Life Orb recoil.

GROVYLE.assessment: A special Unburden template uses Leaf Storm/White Herb, expanded Dragon Pulse and priority; Hoenn authored branches keep their existing physical sets instead.

SCEPTILE.assessment: Special default is catalog context only; all actual Hoenn branches retain their individually authored physical Sceptile sets.

COMBUSKEN.assessment: Special Speed Boost with Feint is catalog context only; Hoenn authored branches retain their exact existing physical moves and offsets.

BLAZIKEN.assessment: Mixed Speed Boost is catalog context only; Hoenn authored branches keep the exact individually reviewed physical ace.

MARSHTOMP.assessment: Slow special spread and Wide Guard are catalog context only; Hoenn authored branches preserve the existing physical Marshtomp.

SWAMPERT.assessment: Bulky special/Wide Guard default is catalog context only; Hoenn authored branches preserve their exact physical Swampert.

GROTLE.assessment: White Herb Shell Smash converts an unevolved tank into physical pressure, with Superpower coverage; require actual speed payoff.

TORTERRA.assessment: White Herb Shell Smash supports powerful Ground/Grass attacks without partner damage; no Mega is introduced.

MONFERNO.assessment: Fake Out and Iron Fist punches provide immediate support and physical coverage rather than another setup dependency.

INFERNAPE.assessment: Fake Out/Helping Hand/Quick Guard support plus Close Combat; preserve native-expanded priority protection.

PRINPLUP.assessment: Competitive, Scald and Icy Wind support both physical and special partners; preserve native-expanded burn pressure.

EMPOLEON.assessment: Competitive special coverage and Shuca survival; responds to opposing stat reduction while remaining offensive.

SERVINE.assessment: Contrary Leaf Storm with Glare and Knock Off supplies a direct win route and utility.

SERPERIOR.assessment: Contrary offense plus Glare/Light Screen; its berry may need a role-preserving conflict substitute in the complete rival team.

PIGNITE.assessment: Bulky physical Fire/Fighting pressure plus Sucker Punch; Thick Fat offers defensive switching utility.

EMBOAR.assessment: Reckless physical Fire and Fighting coverage; its slow bulky nature is preserved rather than adding an untested speed redesign.

DEWOTT.assessment: Fast Icy Wind/Chilling Water and Helping Hand supports the other active slot while retaining direct attacks.

SAMUROTT.assessment: Physical Swords Dance with Water STAB and Aqua Jet; useful under ordinary speed control or as an immediate priority reserve.

QUILLADIN.assessment: Physical bulk, Super Fang and Helping Hand create damage opportunities without weather dependency.

CHESNAUGHT.assessment: Bulletproof and contact punishment sustain the board while Body Press exploits Defense; an alternate defensive endgame.

BRAIXEN.assessment: Fast special Fire/Psychic pressure and Will-O-Wisp for physical mitigation.

DELPHOX.assessment: Power Herb Solar Beam supplies one-turn Water/Ground coverage without sun; preserve its Power Herb rather than arbitrary item replacement.

FROGADIER.assessment: Protean special offense and U-turn; generation-nine once-per-entry behavior is explicit.

GRENINJA.assessment: Fast special Water/Dark/Ice plus U-turn; can reset Protean and reposition without consuming the fixed Mega allocation.

DARTRIX.assessment: Tailwind and Helping Hand support with direct Brave Bird; Long Reach can avoid contact punishment.

DECIDUEYE.assessment: Configured Tinted Lens attacks plus Spirit Shackle trapping; Clear Amulet protects physical investment.

TORRACAT.assessment: Intimidate/Helmet and U-turn support the full rival team while Flare Blitz threatens damage.

INCINEROAR.assessment: Intimidate/Fake Out/Parting Shot provides coherent positioning, while native-expanded Knock Off gives useful item control.

BRIONNE.assessment: Liquid Voice/Hyper Voice and Icy Wind offer strong special spread pressure plus speed control.

PRIMARINA.assessment: Throat Spray Liquid Voice converts a damaging sound move into a further special threat; preserve that specific item synergy.

THWACKEY.assessment: Grassy Surge enables priority and strong physical attacks while supporting grounded healing.

RILLABOOM.assessment: Grassy Surge, Grassy Glide and Drum Beating create priority and speed alternatives; High Horsepower avoids terrain-weakened Earthquake.

RABOOT.assessment: Libero physical Fire/Fighting with U-turn and priority, using the first type change per entry accurately.

CINDERACE.assessment: Band Libero physical pressure; Choice lock and re-entry typing are considered by the shared AI.

DRIZZILE.assessment: Focus Energy/Sniper offers crit pressure with direct Water attacks; setup is conditional on a useful action window.

INTELEON.assessment: Sniper Snipe Shot attacks through redirection and Taunt supports the active partner.

FLORAGATO.assessment: Physical Protean Grass/Fairy coverage plus Sucker Punch; preserve exact move legality and first-entry type change.

MEOWSCARADA.assessment: Flower Trick provides reliable critical offense with Dark coverage and priority; protect the role when replacing a conflicting Sash.

CROCALOR.assessment: Physically bulky Unaware/Wisp/Slack Off supports the board while Flamethrower provides repeatable damage.

SKELEDIRGE.assessment: Unaware Torch Song/Wisp/Hex creates a self-contained special endgame with recovery.

QUAXWELL.assessment: Flip Turn, recovery and hazard removal offer bulky support; its single damaging move still works when no replacement is available.

QUAQUAVAL.assessment: Moxie/Aqua Step gives physical snowballing with immediate Fighting/Dark coverage and Detect.
